hook.en: A sudden voltage spike can destroy a chip. A diode clipper simply slices off any part of the waveform above a chosen level and lets the rest through unchanged.
hook.kn: ಹಠಾತ್ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಏರಿಕೆ ಚಿಪ್ ಅನ್ನು ಹಾಳುಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಡಯೋಡ್ ಕ್ಲಿಪ್ಪರ್ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮಟ್ಟಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮೇಲಿನ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಉಳಿದುದನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಗದೆ ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: A sudden voltage spike can destroy a chip. A diode clipper simply slices off any part of the waveform above a chosen level and lets the rest through unchanged.
narration.kn: ಹಠಾತ್ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಏರಿಕೆ ಚಿಪ್ ಅನ್ನು ಹಾಳುಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಡಯೋಡ್ ಕ್ಲಿಪ್ಪರ್ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮಟ್ಟಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮೇಲಿನ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಉಳಿದುದನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಗದೆ ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A clipper (limiter) removes the part of a waveform above or below a reference level without distorting the remaining part. In a series clipper the diode is in series with the load: the output appears only when the diode conducts. In a shunt (parallel) clipper the diode is across the output after a series resistor: when the diode conducts it short-circuits the output (to its own drop). A positive clipper removes the positive part, a negative clipper the negative part; reversing the diode changes one into the other.

points.en: Clipper = limiter: removes part of the wave
Series clipper: diode in series with load
Reverse the diode to clip the other half

narration.en: A clipper cuts off the part of the wave beyond a level. In a series clipper the diode is in series with the load; in a shunt clipper it is across the output.
narration.kn: ಕ್ಲಿಪ್ಪರ್ ಒಂದು ಮಟ್ಟಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮೀರಿದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಣಿ ಕ್ಲಿಪ್ಪರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಲೋಡ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸರಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಶಂಟ್ ಕ್ಲಿಪ್ಪರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗೆ ಅಡ್ಡಲಾಗಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: On the board: biased shunt clipper.

say.en: The diode and battery sit across the output, after a series resistor R.
With VB = 4 V and a 10 V sine, the output follows the input until it reaches 4.7 V; above that the diode conducts and the top is sliced off.
So the clipping level is VB plus the diode drop. Turn the diode and battery round to clip the negative side instead.

text.en: D conducts when vo > VB + 0.7: top clipped
Reverse D and VB to clip the bottom

narration.en: A shunt diode with a bias battery VB starts to conduct when the input passes VB + Vγ, so everything beyond that level is cut off while the rest of the wave passes unchanged. Two biased diodes facing opposite ways clip both peaks.
narration.kn: ಬಯಾಸ್ VB ಇರುವ ಷಂಟ್ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಒಳಹರಿವು VB + Vγ ದಾಟಿದಾಗ ವಾಹಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಆ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಭಾಗ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಎರಡು ಡಯೋಡ್‌ಗಳು ಎರಡೂ ಶಿಖರ ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: A shunt diode with a bias battery VB starts to conduct when the input passes VB + Vγ, so everything beyond that level is cut off while the rest of the wave passes unchanged. Two biased diodes facing opposite ways clip both peaks.

tryThis.en: Positive clipper with VB = 3 V: at what level is the output cut?
Turn off the 0.7 V drop. How much does the clipping level change?
Choose the two-level clipper and lower VB. What shape does the output approach?

body.en: Adding a battery $V_B$ in series with the diode sets the clipping level at $V_B + V_\gamma$, where $V_\gamma \approx 0.7$ V for silicon. Two biased diodes facing opposite ways clip both peaks, giving a nearly square output between $-(V_{B2} + V_\gamma)$ and $+(V_{B1} + V_\gamma)$. Two Zener diodes back to back clip at $\pm(V_Z + 0.7)$. Clippers protect circuits from over-voltage, remove noise peaks (for example in FM receivers) and shape waves.

points.en: Clipping level = VB + Vγ (0.7 V for Si)
Two biased diodes: both peaks clipped
Uses: protection, noise limiting, wave shaping

narration.en: A battery in series with the diode sets the clipping level at VB plus the diode drop. Two such diodes facing opposite ways clip both peaks.
narration.kn: ಡಯೋಡ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸರಣಿಯ ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಕ್ಲಿಪ್ಪಿಂಗ್ ಮಟ್ಟವನ್ನು VB + 0.7 V ಗೆ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಎರಡು ಡಯೋಡ್‌ಗಳು ಎರಡೂ ಶಿಖರಗಳನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: Biased positive shunt clipper: input (yellow) and output (orange). The output cannot rise above VB + Vγ.

tryThis.en: Set VB = 0 and Vγ = 0: the whole positive half is removed.
Make VB larger than Vm. Is anything clipped now?
Make VB negative. What does the output look like?

narration.en: Biased positive shunt clipper: input (yellow) and output (orange). The output cannot rise above VB + Vγ. Set VB = 0 and Vγ = 0: the whole positive half is removed.

problem.en: A positive shunt clipper uses a silicon diode with VB = 4 V. The input is a 10 V peak sine wave. Describe the output.

steps.en: The diode conducts when vo exceeds VB + 0.7 = 4.7 V.
Positive half: the output follows the input up to 4.7 V and stays there (top clipped).
Negative half: the diode is reverse-biased, so the output follows the input down to −10 V.

problem.en: Two silicon diodes, each with a 3 V battery, are connected facing opposite ways across the output. A 10 V peak sine is applied. Find the output.

steps.en: The output is a nearly square wave between −3.7 V and +3.7 V.
